messages.content: Select exactly one option_id from the current action_options. Return one JSON object with exactly option_id and fact_ids, matching output_schema. Do not invent an action, target, argument, diagnosis, repair, probability, rank, recommendation, or explanation. fact_ids must be exact currently visible non-null IDs. Reading evidence and holding require fact_ids=[]. A probe requires at least one supporting fact ID. For recorded counts, cite at least one complete listed count_evidence_group; if a group is touched, cite all three IDs. Before a probe, distinguish insufficient confirmation evidence from a probe having no useful candidate partition. A symptom is not a confirmed cause. An allowed probe with possible known outcomes that split current candidates may be selected, or hold may be selected at any time. Unknown outcomes confirm no candidate. For recorded counts specifically, a non-normal reference makes the paired outcome unknown. Legacy probes retain their registered raw paired classifier. The host maps the option, verifies evidence, and requires approval before execution.
